narrative.overview:
The laboratory report is the governing metaphor: cool paper, deep indigo letterhead, measured values, source references and written flags. The supplied logo remains bundled locally, including its original ivory image field; that asset does not determine the workspace palette.

This system is extracted from the shipped web source: src/index.css, components/ReportSheet.tsx, components/ResultView.tsx, components/VoiceHero.tsx, components/VoiceHero.css, lib/voice-scene.ts and lib/presentation.ts. The user-selected pathology direction supersedes the earlier family-correspondence world. The subsequently approved startup presence adds a dark indigo introduction and a restrained three-dimensional voice shield; that brand illustration stays separate from measured report evidence. Compact, ruled evidence is the signature; the trust value accompanies the interpretation without a separate raised metric card.
keyCharacteristics: Cool report sheets and indigo letterhead navigation.
One locally bundled sans family with tabular numbers and mono IDs.
Observed values, supplied references and written evidence flags.
Explicit provisional, interrupted, sample and final report states.
A local 3D brand illustration with pause, static reduced-motion and graphics-failure fallback.

rules.name: The Evidence Color Rule
rules.body: Brand indigo identifies actions and navigation. Verdict colors accompany written bands and flags; unknown identity and authority trust ranges remain neutral.

rules.name: The Supplied Reference Rule
rules.body: Show source-provided observed values and thresholds together. Draw an evidence interval only when both supplied values parse as percentages within 0–100; otherwise preserve the text or say that a reference was not supplied.

dos: Do retain the supplied locally bundled logo and fonts.
Do keep brand motion pausable, static under reduced motion and separate from measured evidence.
Do pair verdict color with written labels and keep authority identity unverified.
Do distinguish provisional and interrupted live evidence from a final report.
Do keep source values, thresholds, citations and concerning/reassuring transcript markings inspectable.
Do wrap long report data and prose while preserving unbroken column headings and advisory Source links.
donts: Don't present the decorative shield waveform or orbit pulses as captured audio or signal measurements.
Don't manufacture reference thresholds or treat trust as a probability or guarantee.
Don't display trust or signal scores when audio is insufficient.
Don't use a green trust range for authority checks or speakers without an enrolled match.
